description: Local memory-intelligence evaluation set for MAG. Annotations are ground truth authored from the seed text, not from MAG output, so the harness measures the gap between what MAG does and what a correct memory system would do. Rule for changing an annotation: a case may be rewritten to remove non-determinism, never to make it easier for MAG. Any rewrite that raises a score must leave behind a case that still exercises the original failure.

seed.content: Retries in the payments service use exponential backoff with jitter, capped at 30 seconds.
The payments worker leaked a socket whenever a task was cancelled mid-flight. Closing the handle in the cancellation branch fixed it.
Kubernetes liveness probes must not check downstream dependencies. Readiness probes are the right place for that.
SQLite runs in WAL mode so readers do not block the writer. PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL is set on every connection.
Reviewed the ingest path with Priya Nandakumar. She flagged that spawn_blocking is missing around two synchronous rusqlite calls.
Use SCAN rather than KEYS against Redis in production. KEYS blocks the single-threaded event loop for the whole scan.
Schema changes are verified against the fixture set before merge. Nothing lands without a green fixture run.
I prefer Tailwind over styled-components for the dashboard work.
Ran VACUUM ANALYZE on the ledger tables in Postgres after the bulk delete. Query planning recovered immediately.
CoreML leaked memory on Apple Silicon when the model was reloaded repeatedly, so the embedder pins the ONNX CPU backend.
Handed the migration branch to Marcus. Remaining work is the down-migration and the rollback rehearsal.
Shared mutable state across threads goes behind Arc and a Mutex. The borrow checker catches the races we used to ship.
A trailing slash on proxy_pass in Nginx strips the location prefix from the upstream URL. That is what broke the callback route.
My working timezone is Europe/London.
Put apt-get before COPY in the Dockerfile so the dependency layer stays cached across source changes.
Authentication tokens expire after 24 hours.
Authentication tokens expire after 15 minutes.
Database backups run once a day at 02:00 UTC.
We now snapshot the store every six hours instead of nightly, after the incident in March.
I prefer tabs over spaces for indentation.
I prefer spaces over tabs for indentation.
The dashboard is built with Vite rather than Create React App.
Rate limiting is enforced at 100 requests per minute per IP address.
Nightly backups of the memory database are written to the backups directory on the build host.
Nightly backups of the memory database land in the backups folder, rotated after fourteen days.
Nightly backups of the memory database get copied into the backups directory before the schema migration runs.
The full-text index was rebuilt after the schema change, taking about ninety seconds.
The full-text index was rebuilt following the schema change, with no downtime for readers.
Cross-device synchronisation is deliberately out of scope for the local runtime.
The nightly export job finished and wrote its manifest.
The nightly export job finished and wrote its manifest.
The nightly export job completed and wrote out its manifest file.
Rollback rehearsal for the ledger migration is scheduled for the next maintenance window.
Temporary note: the staging deploy is paused while the certificate is reissued.
The certificate rotation runbook lives in the platform handbook.
Production database credentials are rotated every 90 days.

entities.note: No person, tool or project name appears. 'Retries' and 'payments service' are common nouns.
Describes a defect with no named entity.
Kubernetes is a tool. Classifying it as a person is a precision error.
SCAN and KEYS are commands, not entities.
Apple Silicon is a platform, not a tool entity in MAG's taxonomy.
Arc and Mutex are language items, not entities.
Europe/London is a location, which MAG's taxonomy does not cover.

supersession.note: Same subject, high word overlap, same event_type. Within MAG's cosine and Jaccard gates.
A genuine update stated in different words. Trigram Jaccard is well below 0.30, so MAG is expected to miss it. The annotation records what a correct system should do, not what MAG does.

A reversal of meaning with an identical token set after stopwording and stemming. Content dedup for user_preference fires at 0.75 and discards the new memory, so supersession never runs. The failure is upstream of the supersession gate.
Two unrelated decisions. Superseding here would be a precision failure.

provenance.note: Derived rows must remain traceable to the memories they were built from. This family seeds its own near-duplicates: the grouping seeds are deliberately distinct enough to survive content dedup, so auto_compact would retire nothing and the family would measure nothing.

unimplemented.reason: No production implementation. Structured fact extraction exists only behind --features llm,substrate and its output is never persisted as memories.
unimplemented.target_shape: { facts: [ { subject, predicate, object, confidence, source_memory_id } ] }

unimplemented.reason: MAG has near-duplicate detection, not contradiction detection. The supersession gate requires trigram Jaccard >= 0.30 and cosine >= 0.70, so it fires on rewording and misses contradictions stated in different words.
Consolidation concatenates source content rather than compressing it. There is no summariser to score, so compression ratio is reported instead and is expected to exceed 1.0.
Edges carry four hardcoded types with no predicate vocabulary. There is no typed relationship proposal to score.
Entity slugs are produced by string munging. There is no cross-document entity resolution, so a linking benchmark would score exactly what exact-slug-match yields.
MAG validates a caller-supplied referenced_date but never infers one from text. Write-side coverage is zero by construction.
